question.text: Which SEBI circular introduced templates of Private Placement Memorandum for different categories of AIFs with common disclosure requirements?

answer.text: SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/IMD/DF6/CIR/P/2020/24 dated February 05, 2020

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 13.5 and footnote 131, SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/IMD/DF6/CIR/P/2020/24 dated February 05, 2020 (issued on SEBI website on Feb 6, 2020) introduced templates of PPM for different categories of AIFs, standardising disclosures. The Trap: The 2012 date is when SEBI (AIF) Regulations were notified but not the PPM template circular. October 2021 circular is about merchant banker filing. April 2023 circular is about distribution/placement fees. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A tests this at recall level. XIX-C requires the manager to know the specific circular when drafting/updating PPM and when answering due-diligence queries from LPs. Manager's Pro-Tip: Keep a running log of PPM template amendments — SEBI issues incremental circulars (e.g., Investor Charter December 2021, warehousing disclosures). Your draft PPM must reflect the latest template version at filing.
